title: [GOOD] Typestate pattern prevents invalid route discovery transitions
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Lines: 166-331

What's good: The RouteDiscovery type uses Rust's typestate pattern with phantom types (Idle, Searching, Replied, Failed) to enforce valid state machine transitions at compile time:
- Idle can only transition to Searching (via start())
- Searching can transition to Searching (advance_ring), Replied (receive_rrep), or Failed (fail/exhausted)
- Replied and Failed are terminal states with no outgoing transitions

This eliminates an entire class of runtime bugs where code could accidentally call methods in invalid states.

Worth defending: The pattern adds type complexity but provides compile-time enforcement of the LOADng discovery state machine. Runtime checks are also available via RouteDiscoveryState for dynamic dispatch scenarios.
close_reason: Acknowledged: Positive observation about typestate pattern preventing invalid route discovery transitions.
